page_title: LUT 1-2 MCI | Luton v Manchester City 10/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+7' The resulting corner, taken by Alfie Doughty (Luton), comes to nothing.
90+3' Phil Foden comes off the pitch to be replaced by Manuel Akanji (Manchester City).
90+2' Alfie Doughty (Luton) will deliver the corner kick.
90+2' Alfie Doughty (Luton) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
90+1' The players claim that Ruben Dias (Manchester City) handled the ball and it seems they are right. Luton are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
90+1' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Here's the change. Tom Lockyer leaves the pitch and Jordan Clark (Luton) comes on as a substitute.
89' Manchester City have been awarded an indirect free kick.
84' Rob Edwards has decided to make a change. Tahith Chong (Luton) replaces Ryan Giles.
83' Here comes a substitution. Mateo Kovacic is given a rest as he is replaced by Matheus Nunes (Manchester City).
80' Luton win a corner.
79' What a long-range shot by Julian Alvarez (Manchester City). Unfortunately for him, his shot goes just a few inches over the bar.
79' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
78' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
77' What was Alfie Doughty (Luton) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
73' Rodri (Manchester City) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Andros Townsend trots off the pitch and is replaced by Carlton Morris (Luton).
72' Rob Edwards has decided to substitute Marvelous Nakamba and he is replaced by Albert Sambi Lokonga (Luton).
69' The substitution is prepared. John Stones (Manchester City) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Josko Gvardiol.
68' Luton have been awarded a corner kick.
66' 1 - 2 Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Tim Robinson signals that the goal stands! The Manchester City players celebrate.
65' Possible change! There could be handball by the attacking team in the lead up. Referee Tim Robinson wants to look at it, so he’s going to review using VAR.
65' The Jack Grealish (Manchester City) turns away in celebration as the ball hits the net, but his joy is short-lived as referee Tim Robinson rules it out for a handball.

62' 1 - 1 Goal! Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the bottom left corner. Thomas Kaminski is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 1:1.
60' Ruben Dias (Manchester City) picks up a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot goalwards that crashes against the bar. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
58' Marvelous Nakamba (Luton) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
57' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
56' Marvelous Nakamba (Luton) makes a strong challenge and Tim Robinson blows for a foul. Manchester City have a free kick from a promising distance.
48' Luton can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
48' Ryan Giles (Luton) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball. The ball is out of play. Luton win a corner kick.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.

45+2' Goal! Andros Townsend hands Elijah Adebayo (Luton) the simplest of tasks from close range after the cross evaded the keeper, and he makes no mistake with his header into the top left corner. 1:0.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
40' Kyle Walker (Manchester City) has a go from a long way out but it sails way over. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Luton.
39' Andros Townsend (Luton) sends a long ball in, but Ederson comfortably gathers the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester City.

36' Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) clutches his head after wasting a good opportunity. He expertly collected the ball from a rebound and fired from long range, but his effort wasn't accurate at all and the ball went miles over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Luton.
35' Jack Grealish (Manchester City) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
35' 29:71 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
34' Wonderful movement by Manchester City. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.

33' Andros Townsend (Luton) wastes an opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires in a terrific shot from long range towards the middle of the target, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!

29' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) receives a pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, Thomas Kaminski makes a great save to stop his effort. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Luton.

27' Phil Foden (Manchester City) latches on to an accurate pass into the box and immediately unleashes a low shot goalwards. His effort is well saved by the keeper. The ball goes out of play and Luton will have a goal kick.
27' Marvelous Nakamba (Luton) trips an opposition player and Tim Robinson signals a foul. Manchester City win a free kick.
23' Rodri (Manchester City) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Tim Robinson blows for a foul.
23' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) will take a corner kick.
21' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. Manchester City will take a corner kick.
21' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 0:2.
20' Phil Foden (Manchester City) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
19' Rodri (Manchester City) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed under the crossbar, but Thomas Kaminski was alert and made a comfortable save.
16' The free kick from long range, taken by Luton, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
15' Tim Robinson couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Rodri (Manchester City) and blew his whistle. That's a free kick to Luton.
13' Tim Robinson interrupts the game. One of the players from Luton won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Free kick. Manchester City will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.

12' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Luton are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
10' Tom Lockyer (Luton) commits a rough challenge and Tim Robinson blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick has been awarded to Manchester City.
7' One of the Manchester City players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul. Luton win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.

5' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Amari'i Bell (Luton). Tim Robinson saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Manchester City, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.

2' Phil Foden (Manchester City) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the middle of the goal, but Thomas Kaminski shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Manchester City will have the kick-off.
Tim Robinson will referee today's match.
